findings.first_inherits: Sound: ancestor s reaches u, which reaches b. If b is the earliest reachable entry from s, the earliest entry from u lies before b and is reachable from s. The shared-chain selector and DAG reachability antisymmetry force equality. Disjoint chains and acyclicity remain explicit in Context.
findings.allowed_rebase: Sound directional rebasing. Unconstrained same-chain or unlabelled-target edges remain allowed. For an earliest-entry edge, the prefix of the actual walk proves the new source reaches that endpoint in the augmentation, then legal augmentation recovers original reachability and first_inherits applies.
findings.subwalk_valid: Sound: the decomposition gives an actual allowed prefix from the original source to the subwalk source. Legal augmentation gives original reachability, and allowed_subwalk plus allowed_rebase gives validity relative to the new source.

scope: Hereditary validity of actual filtered walks rebased to their own start vertices. This establishes neither hereditary minimum chain-distance nor existence of a global maximizer with all shortest subpaths, and does not repair the identified optimality obstruction.
checks: Read-only source review. No Lean compilation or edits to proof sources. Source hash verified locally, no remote commit asserted.
